translate_en|mods/RealisticDrivingOverha: Works inside a vehicle. By default it's the key to the right of L (; on US keyboards, ñ on Spanish ones), which the base game doesn't use.
Fasten it with %1 or from the vehicle menu (V)
The water in it looks dirty
Antifreeze: %1 percent (protects down to %2 degrees Celsius)
Antifreeze: %1 percent (protects down to %2 degrees Fahrenheit)
The air filter is clogged. The engine can't breathe and smokes black.
The belt is broken or missing, so the battery doesn't charge and the engine doesn't cool.
The belt is cracked, which is why it squeals.
The oil filter is clogged, so the oil gets dirty sooner.
The oil is black and worn out. Time to change it.
The spark plugs are worn, which is why it misfires.
The tank smells odd, of gasoline and diesel at once.
%1 in the tank. This container takes %2 of %3.
Mixed fuel: %1 of the other fuel can't go in the same container and is lost.
Hold it to disengage the clutch. Only used with 'Use clutch key'.
You hold the clutch to shift, and letting it out badly stalls the engine. Turn it off for an automatic clutch.
Which cars you shift by hand. With Each car as it was, automatics shift by themselves and you shift the cars that had a manual gearbox. The server can choose this for everyone.
When you shift by hand, shifts down a gear. Below first is neutral (N), and with the car stopped one more press engages reverse (R). In R, W drives backwards and S brakes.
When you shift by hand, shifts up a gear.
Automatic gearbox with %1 gears. It shifts by itself. W drives forward, and S brakes and then backs up once the car has stopped.
Manual gearbox with %1 gears that shifts by itself. To shift it yourself, pick another value for Gear shifting in Options > Mods > Roadworthy.
Manual gearbox with %1 gears. %2 shifts up and %3 shifts down. Below first gear is neutral (N), and with the car stopped one more press engages reverse (R). In R, W drives backwards and S brakes.

Automatic gearbox with %1 gears that you shift yourself. %2 shifts up and %3 shifts down. Below first gear is neutral (N), and with the car stopped one more press engages reverse (R). In R, W drives backwards and S brakes.
Manual gearbox with %1 gears that shifts by itself. This game does not allow shifting by hand.
Switches between low and high beams. It only works with the headlights on (the game's F key), and high beams reach further but use more battery.
The battery is too weak to turn it over well
It's too cold for this engine
The engine is worn and has little compression
It's flooded and needs a few minutes
In this cold the glow plugs aren't enough
The starter is worn and may grind
About %1 in 10 tries will start it
May take a few tries to start
Pours %1. The engine has room for %2.
%1 in the engine. This container takes %2.
You need a container that can hold %1 and has room (bottle, jug, can, bucket...), carried or next to you.
You need a container holding only %1, carried or next to you.
You need a wrench to open the drain plug.
Cleans the air the engine breathes. When clogged, the engine loses power and smokes black. Off-road it clogs much sooner.
Drives the alternator and the water pump. A worn belt squeals. If it breaks, the battery stops charging and the engine overheats.
Spark plugs on gasoline engines, glow plugs on diesels. When worn, the engine misfires, jerks, backfires and starts badly. Without them a gasoline engine won't run.
Keeps dirt out of the oil. Clogged or missing, the oil wears out sooner and so does the engine.

Holds the coolant and cools the engine. Right-click it to add coolant or water, or to drain it. Water alone cools just as well, but it boils sooner and in winter it freezes and cracks the radiator, so keep about half antifreeze in it. Bottled coolant comes already mixed. If its condition drops below 40, it leaks while the engine runs and needs repairing and topping up. It must be empty to remove it.
How fast the alternator charges the battery. 1 is what the profile says.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Puddles take grip away at speed. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Exhaust pops draw zombies. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
How fast the battery drains. 1 is what the profile says.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Brakes lose bite when they get hot. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
How hard cars brake. 1 is what the profile says.
Each car brakes like the real one, depending on its brakes and how worn they are. Turn it off and every car brakes the same, as in the base game.
How much bumps and curbs damage wheels and suspension. 1 is what the profile says and 0 removes it.
How hard the holes you can see in the asphalt hit. At 0 they feel like a crack.
How many potholes there are besides the holes you can see on the map. At 0 there are only those.
How hard bumps shake the car. At 0 you feel nothing.
How much cold and rain get in without glass. At 0 nothing does.
With the windshield or a window broken, cold, rain and wind get in. Turn it off and broken glass makes no difference.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Rain gets in when glass is missing. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. The car keeps rolling when you lift off the gas. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
How much a frozen radiator gets damaged. 1 is what the profile says and at 0 it never freezes.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. A crash can kill. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Crashes hurt depending on how hard the hit is and whether you wear a seat belt. Turn it off for no seat belts and no injuries from this mod.
How much crashes hurt. 1 is what the profile says and 0 removes it.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. The radiator leaks after a hard frontal crash. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
How much crashes damage the parts the base game leaves alone. At 0 they don't.

Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. How much worse crash injuries are without a seat belt (1 to 3). The profile sets it, so leave it at 1.5. Any other value overrides the profile.
What happens to the base game's crash injuries. Replace keeps only the mod's, Keep adds both.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Extra factor for diesel cans in loot, multiplied by Spare parts loot (0 to 5). Leave it at 1.0. Any other value is used as it is.
Share of the fuel pumps that sell diesel.
The battery charges and drains like a real one, and an engine in bad shape may not start. Turn it off for the base game's battery and starting.
How much the engine brakes when you lift off the gas. 1 is what the profile says and 0 removes it.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. The engine brakes when you lift off the gas. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. The uneven idle of the engine, like a V8's lope or a diesel's clatter. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Exhaust smoke and the other exhaust effects. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
How much the wind in your face blurs the view. At 0 it doesn't.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Eyes water and the view blurs when glass is missing. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
How much bite brakes lose when they get hot. 1 is what the profile says and 0 removes it.
Diesel and gasoline are different fuels, and the wrong one makes the engine run badly and can damage it. Turn it off for a single fuel, as in the base game.
How much going past the red line damages the engine. 1 is what the profile says and 0 removes it.
With a manual gearbox, how hard the car jerks when a downshift takes the engine past the red line. At 0 the gearbox won't allow it.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. The engine stalls with the manual gearbox. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Each car gets its real gearbox, automatic or manual, with its own gears. Turn it off to go back to the base game's.
How far high beams reach. At 1 they reach as far as base-game headlights.
Adds high beams, which reach further and use more battery.
Start with W like with the key
W starts the engine with the same rules as the key. Turn it off and W starts the car as in the base game.
How far low beams reach. At 1 they reach as far as in the base game.
How often the mod's spare parts and fluids show up. At 0 they never do.
Engines wear out and need looking after. Turn it off and they never wear.
How fast parts and fluids wear out. 1 is what the profile says.

Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Maintenance level (1 none, 2 light, 3 realistic, 4 hardcore). The profile sets it, so leave it at 3. Any other value overrides the profile.

Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Least engine force left when wear, wrong fuel and poor traction add up, as a share of the normal force (0 to 0.5). Leave it at 0.15. Any other value is used as it is.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. The wrong fuel damages the engine. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.

Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. How hard the wrong fuel hits (1 tolerant, 2 realistic, 3 harsh). The profile sets it, so leave it at 2. Any other value overrides the profile.
How much more a broken muffler pops and roars. At 0 nothing changes.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. The engine overheats, loses power and stalls. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
At 0 cars accelerate as in the base game, at 1 like the real ones, and values in between mix the two.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Cargo makes the car slower. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Wheels spin on a poor surface when accelerating. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Each car accelerates like the real one and struggles more when loaded. Turn it off for base-game acceleration.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Bushes no longer stop the car dead. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.

Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Brake and grip preset (1 forgiving, 2 realistic, 3 hardcore). The profile sets it, so leave it at 2. Any other value overrides the profile.
How demanding the mod is. Casual is more forgiving, Realistic behaves like real cars and Hardcore is harsher. The advanced page lets you fine-tune it.
Wheels feel bumps, curbs and the kind of ground, and can get damaged by them. Turn it off and every road is smooth.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Corpses no longer launch or flip the car. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
How much each zombie you run over weighs. The heavier, the more it slows the car.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Hitting a zombie only costs the speed its weight explains. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. The seat belt chime. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. The seat belt. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Who decides which cars are shifted by hand. Any value other than Each player chooses applies to everyone.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. A failed start has a real cause, like the battery, the plugs or the cold. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Each tire grips according to its type, wear, pressure and the ground under it, so a car can slide or pull to one side. Turn it off and tires work as in the base game.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. A soft tire pulls the car to its side. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Traction control on the cars that came with it. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.
Bushes, corpses and lone zombies no longer stop the car dead or throw it. Turn it off for the base game's collisions.
Grip on snow, ice and puddles
How much grip snow, ice and puddles take away. 1 is what the profile says, 2 is double and 0 takes nothing away.
Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Wheels lock when braking hard without ABS. It comes on, and false turns it off whatever the profile says.

Hidden option, only changed in the server's SandboxVars file. Percent of abandoned cars found with the wrong fuel in the tank (0 to 20). The profile sets it, so leave it at 3. Any other value overrides the profile.
